title: memelint.toml
description: The memelint project configuration, at the project root.

profile.description: The severity of each rule before `rules`. basic (the default): unapproved words (1.1) and unknown words (1.6) are off, long sentences (6.3) are warnings. strict: each finding is an error.

subtree-word-lists.description: Globs of word-list files. Each file applies to the directory it is in and to everything below it.

default-word-lists.description: Use the bundled word lists: the software list for all files, and the list of each language for its files. Default: true.

ignore.description: Paths that are not examined, in the syntax of .gitignore.

check.description: Examine the files. Default: true for code, false for prose documents such as Markdown. true examines prose too. The check of a language or a scope applies before this value.

languages.description: The configuration for the files of one language, by tree-sitter grammar name.

default-word-lists.description: Use the bundled list of this language for its files. Default: the top-level value.

check.description: Examine the files of this language. Default: true for code, false for prose documents such as Markdown.

scopes.description: The profile, rules, words and check of the paths that `paths` names. When two scopes name one file, the words of both apply, and the scope that is later in the file sets the severity and the check.

paths.description: The paths of the scope, in the syntax of .gitignore, from the directory of memelint.toml.

profile.description: The severity of each rule in these paths, before the rules. Default: the top-level profile.

check.description: Examine the files in these paths. Default: the check of a scope before it that names the file, then of the language, then the top-level check.

rules.description: The severity of one rule, by ASD-STE100 rule id.

1.1.description: Use only approved words, technical nouns and technical verbs.

1.2.description: Use approved words only as their listed part of speech.

1.6.description: An unapproved word only when it is a technical noun.

6.3.description: Descriptive sentences of at most 25 words.

words.description: Technical names and verbs that the project accepts.

word-lists.description: Word lists that add to the bundled lists. An entry is a path (from the directory of memelint.toml), a URL (that `memelint fetch` puts in the cache), or the name of a bundled list. A list has one word on each line, with # comments.
